name: Yashi Nagomi
source: Nagomi is a first year student from class 1-B. She has a debt of gratitude to [url=/c60]Leo[/url], therefore she becomes a member of student council. She dislikes that she is called "Nagomin" by [url=/c61]Erika[/url]. She is respectful and shows courtesy but she never uses an honorific for her upperclassman [url=/c57]Kinu[/url]. She always acts alone. In the night, she tends to appear in neighborhood of a station for certain circumstances. She has a tough character.
